newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine asks U.S. to go lightly in dumping dispute.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine asks U.S. to go lightly in dumping dispute.

text.p: Ukraine's government told the United States on Thursday that it could ruin the former Soviet republic's steel industry if it implemented a "restrictive" suspension agreement to resolve an anti-dumping dispute.
Deputy Industry Minister Serhiy Hryshchenko told a news conference the two sides had another 30 days to reach agreement in an anti-dumping investigation of cut-to-length carbon steel plate.

An Industry Ministry statement said it feared the U.S. would submit to domestic political pressure "to force a far more restrictive suspension agreement than is required under U.S. law and perhaps even to sacrifice Ukraine's steel industry."
Ukraine exported $187.6 million of steel plate to the U.S. in 1996, the statement said, adding the manufacture of cut-to-length carbon steel plate employed 60,000 people.
